top_needs.title: Practice efficiency gains and ROI with DM-monitored braces and aligners versus standard recall
top_needs.brands_and_products: Damon, Ormco, Spark, Angel, Invisalign, ClearCorrect, Suresmile, KLOwen, Lightforce, SmartSTL, SLB, Twin brackets, self-ligating braces
top_needs.metrics_sought: chair time reduction, appointment frequency, ROI, profitability, time saving, rentability, staff efficiency, practice optimisation, emergency reduction, adaptive aligner change, visit reduction, ongoing monitoring costs vs benefits
top_needs.doctor_objections: I don't see how DM will actually save us time or money. Will it really reduce appointments or chair time, or just add complexity? Is the ROI proven for my practice type and appliance mix?
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: No format preference specified — reps asked for any available evidence
sample_queries: How much chair time reduction achieved
How can I make DM work in a practice with 8 chairs and 15 assistants in a way that they really get the real benefits and make it work financially as well in The Netherlands?
Could you provide any data demonstrating improved patient compliance with DM or its impact on patient outcomes
Are Damon brackets more efficient than other brands?
Real decrease in number of appointments with brackets and aligners without compromising treatment quality and treatment duration
top_needs.gap_assessment: Direct comparative studies quantifying ROI and efficiency for specific appliances (e.g., braces vs aligners, self-ligating vs conventional) are limited. More robust, geographically diverse, and appliance-specific economic analyses are needed.

top_needs.title: Accuracy and reliability of DM’s AI for clinical monitoring and diagnosis versus human assessment
top_needs.brands_and_products: SmartSTL, Spark, Damon, Invisalign, self-ligating braces
top_needs.metrics_sought: AI accuracy, specificity and sensitivity, reliability, comparison to orthodontist, occlusal assessment, passivity detection, unseat tracking
top_needs.doctor_objections: How accurate is the AI compared to a human? Can I trust it to detect clinical issues or will it miss things? I’m skeptical about relying on AI for diagnosis and monitoring.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: academic publication, clinical study, white paper, peer-reviewed
sample_queries: Information on the accuracy of DM, a patient has questioned the ability of the AI to detect clinical observations
Specificity and sensitivity results for FDA application

Occlusal Assessment: A quantitative study validating the AI’s accuracy in detecting malocclusions (midline deviation, overbite, overjet, and canine relationship) found that the mean bias across all parameters was less than 0.5 mm, confirming its reliability as a remote diagnosis and triage tool.
I have a doctor who doesn't trust the accuracy of the AI.  I'd like to receive information regarding the accuracy.
AI accuracy studies, comparison AI reports vs human specialists comparison
top_needs.gap_assessment: Head-to-head studies comparing DM AI to orthodontist assessments for specific clinical findings are rare. More peer-reviewed, quantitative validation studies are needed, especially for new AI features and in diverse populations.
